🤖 Internal Match · 94% confidence AA 661 · Finance · FI-GL
What happened
The system tried to post a vendor invoice but could not find the correct account assignment for your company code and tax code combination. No GL account has been mapped for input tax (MWS condition type) in company code 0001.
What to do — 3 steps
  1. Navigate to SPRO → Financial Accounting → Tax on Purchases/Sales → Posting → Define Tax Accounts
  2. Check key 0001 / KDV2 / MWS and assign the correct input tax GL account
  3. Re-post the original invoice document in MIRO or FB60
SAP Note: 1502808 — Account determination error in tax posting · Est. resolution: ~15 minutes

Relationship Timeline

Chronological record of the customer relationship from executive discovery to post-signature correspondence. Each event is anchored to a source application and document. Select an event to open the evidence drawer.

    Commercial Decisions

    How a 12,400-hour solution became an 8,300-hour fixed-fee baseline at $1.95M. Each decision records who owned it, which approval carried it, and the delivery consequence the team inherits.

    SOW Decision Lineage

    Version-by-version history from AI Hub SOW Generation through SOW Review & Approval to the signed document. Compare any two versions to see what language was added, removed or modified, and why.

    Approval chainSelect an approver to expand comments, conditions and risks acknowledged

    Contract & Scope

    Scope reconciliation across five separate positions — what the customer expects, what the proposal offered, what SOW Generation produced, what approval changed, and what was signed. Customer expectation is never treated as a contractual obligation.

    Staffing Analysis

    Sold staffing versus the minimum staffing the modelled requirement supports. Total hours are not the whole story — capability timing determines whether the Explore phase produces decisions the Realize phase can build on.

    Sold versus recommended effort by workstream

    Sold effort Modelled requirement Critical gap Material gap Sufficient

    Capability timing heatmapCoverage shortfall by phase — deeper color indicates greater risk

    Delivery Strategy

    A practical playbook for the first eight weeks. The objective is to convert assumption-dependent scope into confirmed scope before Realize begins, and to raise commercial conversations progressively rather than at the Explore exit gate.

    Sequenced playbook

    Recommended governance

    Scope Confirmation RegisterMaintained weekly by the Delivery Lead with the Commercial Manager

    Change Forecast

    Foreseeable commercial events based on sales-cycle evidence. These are not planned revenue events. Each represents a requirement the customer may validly hold that sits outside the signed baseline, and each should be discussed openly during Explore.

    ℹ
    How to use this forecastA change request is a transparent response to a validated requirement outside the agreed baseline — never a predetermined tactic. Raise each item with the customer as soon as evidence supports it, so the decision is theirs and the cost is visible early.

    Evidence Library

    Every source behind this analysis, with its contractual authority stated. AI Hub SOW Generation and SOW Review & Approval are structured application sources, not uploaded files — they carry decision history directly.

    What this analysis does not replace

    Interpretations on this page are generated by the AI Hub from the sources listed above. Confidence percentages describe how consistently the underlying evidence supports a statement — they are not a substitute for human approval, and a high confidence score carries no contractual weight.

    Nothing here amends the signed MSA or SOW. Where an AI interpretation and the signed language differ, the signed language governs. Conflicting statements are surfaced rather than silently reconciled, because the conflict itself is usually the thing the delivery team needs to see.

    Legal review remains with Legal, commercial approval with Finance and the Sales Partner, and delivery feasibility with the Delivery Executive. Use the human validation controls to record that a person has checked an interpretation.
